title: Privacy Policy
intro: Chai Shots Private Limited ("we", "our", or "us") operates the Chai Shots OTT platform ("App" or "Service"). We are committed to protecting your privacy and safeguarding your information in compliance with applicable Indian data protection laws, including the Information Technology Act, 2000 and the Information Technology (Reasonable Security Practices and Procedures and Sensitive Personal Data or Information) Rules, 2011.
consent_text: By registering for, accessing, or using the Chai Shots App, you expressly consent to the collection, use, processing, storage, and sharing of your personal data in accordance with this Privacy Policy. You also consent to the transfer of your data to trusted third-party service providers for the purposes outlined herein, and to the processing and storage of your data on servers located in India.
info_collect_intro: We collect the following categories of personal and usage information when you use the App:
info_collect_a_text: We may collect and store the following information when you use our App: Name and mobile number; Login credentials and password; Subscription and payment details; Communications sent via in-app chat or email (e.g., support queries, feedback, or survey responses); and any referral code used or promotional coupon redeemed.
info_collect_b_text: When you access or use the App, we automatically collect certain information to help us operate, secure, and improve the service. This includes: Device and Technical Information (IP address, device type, device ID, operating system version, app version, and network provider); Usage and Behavioral Data (Watch history, search queries, time spent on videos, clickstream data, navigation patterns, and interaction metrics within the App); Location Data (Approximate geographic location, which may be inferred from your IP address or device settings); and Crash Reports and Diagnostics (System logs and performance data to help us identify and fix technical issues).
use_info_text: We use your information to provide, operate, and maintain the Chai Shots App and its associated services. This includes managing your account and providing access to content; processing subscriptions and payments through our partners; personalizing your experience with content recommendations; communicating important service-related updates and promotional offers; responding to support queries and feedback via Intercom; analyzing usage to improve App performance and content strategy; and detecting and preventing fraud and ensuring platform security.
data_sharing_text: We do not sell or rent your personal data. We may share your information with trusted third-party service providers, including: Payment Partners (Razorpay and Setu UPI Autopay for secure transaction processing); Content Delivery (Google Media CDN to optimize video streaming performance); Analytics (PostHog and Appsflyer to understand user engagement and measure campaigns); Communications (Intercom and CleverTap for in-app support and user engagement); and Advertising (Google Ads and Meta Ads for promotional purposes, using anonymized data only).
data_sharing_corp_text: In the event of a merger or acquisition, your data may be transferred to the new entity.
data_sharing_affiliates_text: We may share info with our affiliated companies under the same privacy terms.
legal_basis_text: By using the App, you expressly consent to the processing of your personal data as described in this Policy, including storage on servers in India and sharing with third-party partners for operational and marketing purposes. You may withdraw your consent at any time, though this may limit your access to the Service.
user_rights_text: You have the right to access and request a copy of the personal information we hold, request corrections to inaccurate data, or request deletion of your account. Requests can be made via in-app support or by emailing support@chaishots.in.
data_retention_text: We retain billing information for up to five (5) years and usage data for up to two (2) years. Accounts inactive for more than twelve (12) months may be subject to anonymization or deletion.
security_text: We use industry-standard encryption and Digital Rights Management (DRM) to protect your data. However, no internet transmission is 100% secure, and you use the App at your own risk.

updates_text: We may update this Policy periodically. Material changes will be notified via in-app pop-ups.
governing_law_text: This Policy is governed by the laws of India. Disputes are subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts in Hyderabad, Telangana.
